content:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v1.12.0 -> canary (us-west-2). pipeline ci/6789. image: redwood/runtime:1.12.0-rc

alex_m: Seeing a spike of 5xx from canary in the last 30s on /v1/generate - multiple timeouts. Can confirm load balancer 502s.

sophia: Sentry shows a bunch of request timeouts and model-serving errors (OOM-ish patterns). Trace sample: trace_id=tr_0a1b2c

oncall_pg: @pagerduty-> paging oncall. Severity: high. Please acknowledge.

pagerduty: Triggered oncall: @oncall_pg acknowledged at 3412340020.

james: Quick check on image digests: canary pods are running redwood/runtime:1.12.0-rc but registry digest != expected. Looks like CI retagged a stale CI build onto that tag.

james: command outputs:
```
$ docker inspect --format='{{.Id}}' registry.redwood/redwood/runtime:1.12.0-rc
sha256:abc123stale
$ expected sha256:def456stable
```

maria_se: If the canary got a bad image, we should flip the feature flag kill-switch and rollback the canary image. Who can flip LD flag? @sophia

sophia: On it — flipping LaunchDarkly flag "v1.12-preview" -> OFF. Will post when done. :gear:

sophia: Flag is OFF now.

alex_m: After flag off, error rate on canary dropped from 18% -> 1.8% within a minute. Latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

james: I'll prepare image rollback to redwood/runtime:1.11.9-stable and restart canary pods. Doing kubectl rollout undo on deployment/redwood-runtime-canary -> patch image.

james: Commands I ran:
```
kubectl set image deploy/redwood-runtime-canary runtime=registry.redwood/redwood/runtime:1.11.9-stable -n prod-canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-runtime-canary -n prod-canary
```

deploy-bot: Rollout to 1.11.9-stable complete for canary. Health checks passing.

oncall_pg: Customer impact estimate: ~2% of traffic routed to canary, error spike lasted ~10 minutes before flag kill and rollback. No mitigations required for prod stable. Support notified to watch for any user reports.

sophia: Opening follow-up incident ticket: INC-2023-789 (CI retag race -> wrong digest on release tag). Assigning to eng-infra + eng-releases. Adding logs and digest diffs.

maria_se: Recommend temporary CI gate: require digest-confirmation step before tagging release -> will draft PR.

alex_m: thumbs up. Closing this oncall thread unless new alerts appear.

deploy-bot: Incident bot: manual ack recorded. If errors reappear escalate to Sev2.
